carries: QA wave. The scanner: an empty or unreadable label answered safe — a green verdict on no information; it now has its own unreadable state. The word Ingredients: was read as an unknown food, which pushed a clear label to uncertain and buried the may-contain warning behind it; headings and trailing punctuation are no longer foods, so a trace warning surfaces as caution, which informs rather than blocks
the engine refuses to call a recipe safe when it holds an ingredient the catalogue does not know; the validator already blocked these upstream, this is the second line
the subscription price comes from StoreKit in the user's currency and store, with the renewal period spelled by StoreKit; a hard-coded 4.99 was wrong the moment a price differs by country
midnight and the return from background refresh the plan; the day marker and the hero stayed on the previous day until the app was killed
the artifact carries Montreal time: TZ moves the job's clock but upload-artifact rewraps the file without reading it, so the stamp is set explicitly
Info.plist pointed at 0.6.0 while project.yml built 1.0.0; it now points at the real source, and declares the standard HTTPS encryption exemption
labels for the icon-only buttons in cooking mode; the exclusion phrases in the photo prompt fit under the 500-character limit again
the cooked tick is ink rather than verdict green, now that the row carries no verdict; the origin note gets a faint dark field so it reads on a pale photo, level with the pill below
build fix: the accessibility label was inserted between an argument and its continuation, which the compiler reports as a missing comma
